signals.title_or_quote: [High] Build a governance dashboard for feature flag audit trail review
signals.why_relevant: Requests audit trail for feature flags, core to togglr's PR-based review model
signals.drafted_reply: A governance dashboard with full audit trail would help track who changed what in production. I'm building togglr, where every flag change is a pull request with attribution and rollback. I'd love to learn from your use case.

rescore.why: The thread is a GitHub issue requesting a governance dashboard built on top of an existing audit SQL schema — it's a feature-build task for their own codebase, not a search for a third-party feature flag tool.

signals.title_or_quote: Integrate KYC/AML provider with retry, status callbacks, and replayable audit trail
signals.why_relevant: Mentions replayable audit trail, aligning with togglr's git-backed change history
signals.drafted_reply: Replayable audit trails ensure traceability for compliance and debugging. At togglr, we implement this via git-backed flag configs where every change is a PR. I'm the builder and would value your feedback on our approach.

rescore.why: The thread is about integrating a KYC/AML provider with webhooks, retry logic, and audit trails — not about feature flag management, review workflows, or flag evaluation latency.

signals.why_relevant: Combines edge evaluation and feature flags, matching togglr's sub-5ms edge execution
signals.drafted_reply: Edge-based feature flags can reduce latency and improve reliability. togglr evaluates flags at the edge in under 5ms p99 using Cloudflare Workers. I'm the creator and would be glad to share how we handle config sync and rollout safety.

rescore.why: The thread is an architectural scoping discussion about whether a Kubernetes deployment tool called Kitchen should build its own feature flag system or defer to existing solutions — the author is explicitly parking this as out of scope, not seeking a feature flag tool to adopt.

signals.why_relevant: Team exploring feature flag implementation, early stage but relevant
signals.drafted_reply: When adopting feature flags, consider how changes are reviewed and rolled back. togglr treats flag updates as pull requests with full history. I'm the builder and happy to discuss safe rollout patterns.

rescore.why: The thread author has already made a firm decision to use Flipt v2 self-hosted with git-native YAML flags, so recommending an alternative feature flag tool would not be helpful.

signals.title_or_quote: If coding gets faster, where should architecture happen? A feature works. The team ships it. But Ralph has problems when you move beyond one-off tasks: 1. Overcooking
signals.why_relevant: Discusses feature delivery risks, context where unreviewed flags cause issues
signals.drafted_reply: As features ship faster, unreviewed flag changes become risk hotspots. We built togglr to require PR review for every toggle change, with edge evaluation under 5ms. I'm the founder and believe safety shouldn't slow velocity.

rescore.why: HN thread locked (older than 14 days) — cannot reply
